corrections.reason: Visual inspection of Col 2 L14 shows 6th-order እ and 4th-order ባ (with shortened left leg), reading እንዳባትነቱ ('in his capacity as a spiritual father').
In canonical Ge'ez Luke 1:3 and on the page image (Col 3 L10), the honorific title for Theophilus is አእዛዝ (with 4th-order ዛ, shortened left leg), not አእዚዝ.
Matches the canonical Ge'ez title አእዛዝ ታዖፊላ and the 4th-order ዛ glyph visible on Col 3 L19.
Joined across L26-L27, the Ge'ez relative verb is ዘአንበረ ('who established', 1st-order አ), clearly visible at the end of L26 without the middle loop of እ.
